lines.text: The LORD founded His city on the holy mountains and loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Glorious things are ascribed to the city of God.
The LORD says He will mention Rahab and Babylon, along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush, among those who know Him.
It will be said that this one and that one were born in Zion, and the sons of Korah will establish her.
The LORD will record in the register of the peoples that this one was born in Zion, and priests and trumpeters will proclaim joy.
